page.content:
2021 film that opened Generation 5 after Friendship Is Magic.

How My Little Pony: A New Generation connects

  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Friendship Is Magic is the series A New Generation follows.
  • Topic: My Little Pony — A New Generation opens the Generation 5 chapter of My Little Pony.

What is My Little Pony: A New Generation?

A New Generation is the CG film that follows Friendship Is Magic, sending a new earth pony into an Equestria that has forgotten how unicorns, pegasi, and earth ponies once lived together.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic and My Little Pony.
